name: Crypto Alerts Template
description: Template structure for BTC/ETH/SOL price alerts using RSI/EMA signals, sent via Telegram. Replace placeholder node configs with real credentials in n8n (never commit real API keys/tokens here).

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every N minutes to check prices

nodes.name: Binance - Get Price Data
nodes.notes: Fetch OHLCV candles for BTCUSDT / ETHUSDT / SOLUSDT from Binance public API

nodes.name: Calculate EMA
nodes.notes: Compute EMA (e.g. 12/26 period) from candle closes

nodes.name: Signal Condition
nodes.notes: Trigger alert only when RSI/EMA cross thresholds

nodes.name: Generate Arabic Summary (Claude)
nodes.notes: Call Anthropic API to generate a short Arabic summary of the signal

nodes.name: Send Telegram Alert
nodes.notes: Send the generated summary to the configured Telegram chat/channel

connections.note: Define node-to-node connections here once real node IDs are set in n8n
